description: This file contains partial class implementations and extension methods related to AdoNet streaming configuration within Orleans. It includes classes for configuration options, validators, and configurator extensions for both client and silo components, as well as static helper methods for adding AdoNet streams to client and silo builders.

classes.name: AdoNetStreamOptions
classes.description: Represents configuration options for AdoNet streaming, including connection string, various timeout intervals, and retry policies.

classes.name: AdoNetStreamOptionsValidator
classes.description: Validates the AdoNetStreamOptions configuration to ensure proper setup.

classes.name: ClusterClientAdoNetStreamConfigurator
classes.description: Configures AdoNet streams on Orleans cluster clients, including options for cache size and partition count.

classes.name: SiloAdoNetStreamConfigurator
classes.description: Configures AdoNet streams on Orleans silos, including cache size and partitioning.

methods.name: ConfigureAdoNet
methods.description: Configures AdoNet streaming options using a provided action for options builder.

methods.name: ConfigureCache
methods.description: Sets the cache size for AdoNet streams.

methods.name: ConfigurePartitioning
methods.description: Sets the number of partitions for AdoNet streams.

methods.name: AddAdoNetStreams
methods.description: Extension method to add AdoNet streams to an IClientBuilder with configuration options.

methods.name: AddAdoNetStreams
methods.description: Extension method to add AdoNet streams to an IClientBuilder with a configurator delegate.

methods.name: ConfigureAdoNet
methods.description: Configures AdoNet streaming options on a SiloAdoNetStreamConfigurator.

methods.name: ConfigureCache
methods.description: Sets cache size on a silo configurator.

methods.name: ConfigurePartitioning
methods.description: Sets partition count on a silo configurator.
